sections.title: Conditioning
sections.meta: Stability Circuit · 2 rounds · steady pace · no rest between exercises

items.rx: 3–4 progressively heavier sets to working weight

items.text: Pull-up fallback: If a rep slows noticeably or you start to kip, stop and finish that set's reps with a band.

sections.title: Conditioning

items.text: If control breaks on a single-leg movement (hips rotate, knee caves, balance lost more than once in a set), drop to the previous variation and keep the prescribed sets and reps.

items.n: Standing Calf Raise, loaded, off a step

items.text: Ring row fallback: Chest-Supported DB Row.

items.rx: 3 × 2 · jump or step to top, 5-sec lower

items.text: Choose loads you can perform unbroken through the first round. Loads listed men's / women's. With 8+ strict pull-ups, use strict or kipping pull-ups in place of band-assisted.
